The '''2021–22 season''' was [[Tottenham Hotspur F.C.|Tottenham Hotspur]]'s 30th season in the [[Premier League]], 44th successive season in the top division of the [[English football league system]] and 140th season in existence. After finishing seventh in the [[2020–21 Premier League]], Tottenham qualified for the play-off round of the newly formed [[UEFA Europa Conference League]]. At the end of June, the club announced [[Nuno Espírito Santo]] as the new head coach on a two-year contract.<ref>{{cite web |title=Nuno Espírito Santo appointed new Head Coach |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/june/nuno-espirito-santo-appointed-new-head-coach/ |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=30 June 2021 |access-date=2 July 2021}}</ref> However, Tottenham announced that they had removed Nuno, along with his coaching staff Ian Cathro, Rui Barbosa and Antonio Dias, stating they had been "relieved of their duties" on 1 November 2021.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/october/club-announcement/ |title=Club Announcement |work=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=1 November 2021 |access-date=1 November 2021 }}</ref> [[Antonio Conte]] was appointed as Nuno's successor the following day.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/october/antonio-conte-appointed-new-head-coach/ |title=Antonio Conte appointed new Head Coach |work=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=2 November 2021 |access-date=2 November 2021 }}</ref>

== Pre-season and friendlies ==
Tottenham scheduled an away match against [[Leyton Orient F.C.|Leyton Orient]] for the JE3 Foundation Trophy in memory of [[Justin Edinburgh]]. Tottenham then scheduled two friendlies, one away to [[Colchester United F.C.|Colchester United]],<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/july/colchester-united-added-to-pre-season-schedule/ |title=Colchester United added to pre-season schedule |work=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=8 July 2021 |access-date=26 December 2021 }}</ref> and one away to [[Milton Keynes Dons F.C.|Milton Keynes Dons]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/june/leyton-orient-and-mk-dons-friendlies-confirmed/ |title=Leyton Orient and MK Dons friendlies confirmed |work=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=28 June 2021 |access-date=28 June 2021 }}</ref> Tottenham announced the club would come together with both [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] and [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] to support mental health in The Mind Series in August 2021. They would play away to Chelsea and home to Arsenal.<ref>{{cite news |title=Arsenal, Chelsea and Spurs to compete in The Mind Series |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/june/arsenal-chelsea-and-spurs-to-compete-in-the-mind-series/ |work=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |date=22 June 2021 |access-date=24 June 2021}}</ref>

=== FA Cup ===
{{main|2021–22 FA Cup}}

Tottenham were drawn home to [[Morecambe F.C.|Morecambe]] in the third round<ref>{{cite news |title=Third round Draw |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2021/dec/06/emirates-fa-cup-third-round-proper-draw-20210612 |date=6 December 2021 |publisher=The Football Association |access-date=9 December 2021}}</ref> and [[Brighton & Hove Albion F.C.|Brighton & Hove Albion]] in the fourth round,<ref>{{cite news |title=Fourth round Draw |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2022/jan/09/emirates-fa-cup-fourth-round-proper-draw-20220901 |date=9 January 2022 |publisher=The Football Association |access-date=9 January 2022}}</ref> and were drawn away to [[Middlesbrough F.C.|Middlesbrough]] in the fifth round.<ref>{{cite news |title=Fifth round Draw |url=https://www.thefa.com/news/2022/feb/06/emirates-fa-cup-fifth-round-proper-draw-20220602 |date=6 February 2022 |publisher=The Football Association |access-date=6 February 2022}}</ref>

=== EFL Cup ===
{{main|2021–22 EFL Cup}}

Tottenham entered the competition in the third round as one of the teams competing in [[UEFA competitions]]. They were drawn away to [[Wolverhampton Wanderers F.C.|Wolverhampton Wanderers]] in the third round<ref>{{cite web |title=Carabao Cup Round Three draw confirmed |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2021/august/carabao-cup-round-three-draw-confirmed/ |publisher=EFL |access-date=26 August 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Wolves v Spurs - Carabao Cup date and KO time |url=https://www.tottenhamhotspur.com/news/2021/august/wolves-v-spurs-carabao-cup-dateko-time/ |publisher=Tottenham Hotspur F.C. |access-date=29 August 2021}}</ref> and [[Burnley F.C.|Burnley]] in the fourth round.<ref>{{cite web |title=Carabao Cup Round Four draw: confirmed ties |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2021/september/carabao-cup-round-four-draw-confirmed-ties/ |publisher=English Football League |access-date=23 September 2021}}</ref> They were drawn home to [[West Ham United F.C.|West Ham United]] in the quarter-finals.<ref>{{cite web |title=Carabao Cup Quarter-Final draw: confirmed ties |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2021/october/carabao-cup-quarter-final-confirmed-ties/ |publisher=English Football League |date=30 October 2021 |access-date=13 December 2021}}</ref> They were drawn to [[Chelsea F.C.|Chelsea]] in the semi-finals, with the first leg away and the second leg home.<ref>{{cite web |title=Carabao Cup Semi-Final draw |url=https://www.efl.com/news/2021/december/carabao-cup-semi-final-draw/ |publisher=English Football League |date=21 December 2021 |access-date=23 December 2021}}</ref>
